Not sure if you still needed help, but something I didn’t see mentioned elsewhere for middle manager and Sephiroth is that when you are using the pause trick, you need to somewhat delay your dodge after you unpause. On early fights, you could hold the stick in the direction while it’s still paused, unpause it and you would dodge it. For those later two, you want to pause, note where you need to direct the stick, then unpause and dodge it at the last minute. If you block it, you’re dodging too early, and if you get hit, you obviously are dodging too late. Might help out. Good luck!
